messages:
From: VendorPortal Onboarding <onboarding@vendorportals.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@brightleaf.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial inventory + tempcred window for Brightleaf onboarding

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for choosing VendorPortal for Brightleaf's security profile. Attached is a preliminary manifest (brightleaf_manifest_v1.csv) that lists the artifact types we typically accept for SOC2/SIG/CAIQ evidence.

Two quick asks to move fast:
- Can Redwood confirm which evidence bucket we should expect (S3 vs presigned uploads)?
- Are you ok with a 48-hour temporary credential window for staged uploads? We usually provide a TTL window and accept a signed manifest.

I've copied Sam at Brightleaf to ensure the scope matches their internal expectations. We'll follow up with an assertion matrix template if you confirm the bucket and owner mapping.

Attachments: brightleaf_manifest_v1.csv (csv stub)

Best,
VendorPortal Onboarding
onboarding@vendorportals.io

VendorPortal onboarding team
https://vendorportals.io/onboarding

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: VendorPortal Onboarding <onboarding@vendorportals.io>, Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial inventory + tempcred window for Brightleaf onboarding

Thanks — manifest received. A few clarifications from our side before we sign off:

Scope decisions we need today from Brightleaf (Sam):
- Evidence target: do you want us to upload to your S3 bucket (preferred by Brightleaf) or to VendorPortal's presign flow?
- Owner mapping: who on Brightleaf owns the SOC2 artifacts vs the SIG matrix?

Redwood constraints / ask:
- We prefer presigned uploads to your S3 bucket where possible (reduces data custody issues). If VendorPortal must host temporarily, TTL needs to be exactly 24h and logable.
- For temporary credentials: Redwood security requires an auditable manifest + name/email of the person who requested the temporary credentials.

Karthik — can you (1) list the minimal set of S3 object prefixes we expect (for the manifest), and (2) draft a short presign example we can hand to VendorPortal? We have an internal presign snippet we can share. Marissa — can you pull the current assertion matrix template so we can align fields?

I'll compile a short playbook once we get these items.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head, Security Intake | Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference

From: VendorPortal Onboarding <onboarding@vendorportals.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@brightleaf.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial inventory + tempcred window for Brightleaf onboarding

Thanks for the quick reply, Hannah. We're fine with a presign-to-customer-bucket flow. Our platform accepts either a presigned PUT (preferred) or temporary STS creds for a short window. We can tighten TTL to 24h and emit upload logs to a webhook you specify.

I've attached an assertion_matrix_draft.xlsx with the CAIQ->SIG mapping we've used for similar customers. For presign examples, see s3-presign-examples.txt (attached).

Action items submitted on our side:
- We'll add a flag in the VendorPortal UI: "presign_to_customer_bucket" and include a webhook for upload events.
- We will require the manifest (with prefixes) at kickoff to pre-create the expected upload paths.

Attachments: assertion_matrix_draft.xlsx (xlsx stub), s3-presign-examples.txt (txt stub)

Best,
VendorPortal Onboarding

Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial inventory + tempcred window for Brightleaf onboarding

Folks — quick technical notes and a minimal manifest sample below.

Minimal S3 prefixes Redwood expects (example):
- brightleaf/soc2/2025-2027/controls/
- brightleaf/sig/2027/caiq/
- brightleaf/attestations/

Sample manifest row (CSV):
object_prefix,expected_file_type,control_tag,owner_email
brightleaf/soc2/2025-2027/controls/,pdf,CC1,handover@brightleaf.com

Presign snippet (we'll hand to VendorPortal):
- PUT https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/brightleaf/{object_prefix}{filename}?X-Amz-...
- Headers: x-amz-meta-requester: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com; x-amz-meta-declared-control: CC1

About temporary STS creds: we prefer presigns. If STS is necessary, Redwood requires: caller identity, IAM role ARN, request timestamp, and a signed request from the Brightleaf owner. No anonymous STS is permitted.

I'll attach a tiny CSV example to the Drive link Hannah shared. Once VendorPortal confirms the webhook and TTL, we can start a short staging window for uploads.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Infra Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: VendorPortal Onboarding <onboarding@vendorportals.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@brightleaf.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -07:00

Great — that aligns. Final checklist before kickoff:
- [Sam] Confirm Brightleaf upload bucket ARN and primary owner email (handover@brightleaf.com) — due EOD Thu 3/4
- [VendorPortal] Provide webhook URL for upload events and confirm TTL = 24h (vendor to confirm by EOD Wed 3/3)
- [Karthik] Share small CSV manifest in Drive (done) and confirm presign headers (done)
- [Marissa] Populate assertion matrix with Redwood's control tags and share link (please complete by 3/4)

We'll open a 36-hour staging window on Fri 3/5 once the above are complete. If anyone needs a shorter TTL or additional logging fields, flag now.

Thanks everyone — I'll move this thread to an action tracker and post the doc link when Marissa's matrix is available.

Hannah
Head, Security Intake | Redwood Inference
